url.description: External URL for the publication's website.

via.description: Identifier of the third-party client that wrote this record (e.g. 'tech.tokimeki'). Set only by clients other than mochott itself; mochott indexes such records from the firehose.

icon.description: Icon or logo image for the publication.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the publication was created.

description.description: Short description of the publication, shown in listings and feeds.

socialLinks.description: Links to the publication's accounts on other services, in display order.

primaryColor.description: Primary theme color as a CSS color value (e.g. '#3b82f6').

backgroundColor.description: Background theme color as a CSS color value.

standardPublication.description: AT URI of the site.standard.publication record the client created together with this profile. Only read when 'via' is set.

main.description: Profile for a mochott publication. Each account has at most one profile, stored with the fixed record key 'self'.

uri.description: An http(s) URL. Renderers must ignore any other scheme.

label.description: The name shown for a 'link'. Ignored for other platforms, which are shown by their service's name.

platform.description: The service the link points at. 'link' is a link with its own label and may appear more than once; every other value at most once.

description: A publication profile record. Acts as a signaling record indicating the account hosts a mochott publication.
